crossRefs.note: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
which in its own times he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings, and Lord of lords.
I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.
Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.
But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind…
As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But…

translations.web: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
translations.bsb: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
translations.kjv: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
translations.asv: Blessed art thou, O Jehovah: Teach me thy statutes.
